question: Does the pinned-upstream-protocol-aligned official LeWM teacher produce a non-floor success rate under the pinned upstream PushT dataset-driven evaluation?

scope.loader_exception: Use the project's previously validated load_official_checkpoint helper to load the existing serialized official object at stablewm_home/pusht/lewm_object.ckpt. No HF mirror, alternate checkpoint, or download is allowed.
scope.output_exception: World.evaluate receives video=None to avoid writing videos; task selection, preprocessing, policy, solver, callables, budget, and success evaluation remain aligned. The upstream small pusht_results.txt output is retained; selected-task and JSON result sidecars are additive.

upstream_protocol.provenance_note: Commit IDs are staging provenance/reference only. Remote source trees are staged snapshots without Git metadata; runtime guards check imported roots and API/config semantics, not exact commit identity.

preprocess.action_proprio_state: fit sklearn StandardScaler on all dataset rows after removing rows with any NaN in that column
preprocess.pixels_goal: ToImage, float32 scaled to [0,1], ImageNet Normalize, Resize(224)

upstream_protocol.selection: Reproduce eval.py exactly: unique episode IDs; episode length=max(step_idx)+1; per-episode maximum start=length-goal_offset_steps-1; valid rows satisfy step_idx<=maximum; rng=default_rng(42); choice(len(valid_indices)-1, size=50, replace=False); sort selected row indices; retrieve episode ID and step_idx. Preserve the upstream len(valid_indices)-1 bound.

dataset_source.cache_layout: job-private cache/datasets/pusht_expert_train.h5 symlink to the staging file

outcomes_and_gates.primary_outcome: count of successful episodes among the exact 50 selected dataset rows, using World.evaluate episode_successes
validity: PBS compute-node and imported source-root guards pass
outcomes_and_gates.engineering_continuation_gate: At least 5/50 successes makes this baseline eligible for a later same-task paired multi-arm design. 0-4/50 stops this line pending diagnosis. This is an engineering floor gate, not a statistical test or success claim.
outcomes_and_gates.no_extension: No additional rows, reruns, four-arm evaluation, checkpoint substitution, or task selection based on outcomes in this experiment.

task_unit_and_pairing.unit: one sampled dataset row (row_index, episode_idx, start_step)
task_unit_and_pairing.persisted_before_rollout: selected_tasks.json records all 50 exact task keys and source dataset metadata
task_unit_and_pairing.later_comparison_rule: If the engineering gate passes, any follow-up multi-arm comparison requires its own pre-results freeze and should reuse these exact task keys for every arm; preserve all transforms/scalers/callables/budget and freeze arm run order before outcomes. Record repeated source episode IDs and treat them as clusters in later inference.

resources.queue_selection_reason: The normal route queue is the authorized submission entry point and routes to gdev. qstat shows gdev is from_route_only, accepts 1 GPU and a 2-hour walltime; this frozen request fits that target. Direct qsub to gdev was rejected and created no job.
resources.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi utilization and memory every 5 seconds to job.log
resources.monitor_cleanup: trap terminates and waits for the direct nvidia-smi monitor PID

method_reference: Kassis, Agarwal, He, Patel, and Brueckner, Scientific Agent Skills, arXiv:2609.00065 v2 (2026-09-02), https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
